entry.en: To enter Comoros, your passport must expire at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Para entrar en Comoras, tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Comoros, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Always travel with your ID and keep printed copies of your passport's photo page and visa stamp.
entry.es: Viaja siempre con tu documento y guarda copias impresas de la página de la foto del pasaporte y del sello del visado.
entry.quote: Always travel with your ID. Keep printed copies of your passport’s photo page and visa stamp.

entry.en: For the visa on arrival, have the exact amount in cash because change might not be given.
entry.es: Para el visado a la llegada, lleva el importe exacto en efectivo, pues quizá no den cambio.
entry.quote: Have the exact amount in cash, because change might not be given.

entry.en: The immigration paperwork asks for a place of residence during your stay, but it is not checked.
entry.es: El formulario de inmigración pide un lugar de residencia durante la estancia, pero no se comprueba.
entry.quote: The immigration paperwork asks that you list a place of residence for your stay in the Comoros, but it is not checked.

safety.en: Protests and unrest can happen in Comoros, including in Moroni, Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli, particularly following elections.
safety.es: Pueden producirse protestas y disturbios en Comoras, incluidas Moroni, Gran Comora, Anjouan y Mohéli, sobre todo tras las elecciones.
safety.quote: Protests and unrest can happen in Comoros, including in Moroni and other parts of Grande Comore, Anjouan and Mohéli, particularly following elections.

safety.en: Crime levels are low, but take precautions against pickpocketing.
safety.es: Los niveles de delincuencia son bajos, pero conviene protegerse de los carteristas.
safety.quote: Crime levels are low but take precautions against pickpocketing.

safety.en: Boats and ferries between the islands can be overloaded, in poor condition and without life jackets.
safety.es: Los barcos y transbordadores entre las islas pueden ir sobrecargados, en mal estado y sin chalecos salvavidas.
safety.quote: They can be overloaded, in poor condition and without life jackets.

safety.en: Tropical cyclones can affect Comoros between January and May.
safety.es: Los ciclones tropicales pueden afectar a Comoras entre enero y mayo.
safety.quote: Tropical cyclones can affect Comoros between January and May.

safety.en: Karthala, near Moroni on Grande Comore, is an active volcano that last erupted in 2007.
safety.es: El Karthala, cerca de Moroni en Gran Comora, es un volcán activo que entró en erupción por última vez en 2007.
safety.quote: Karthala, near Moroni on Grande Comore, is an active volcano which last erupted in 2007.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Comoros.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo es ilegal en Comoras.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is illegal in Comoros.

health.en: Malaria is prevalent in the Comoros, and the text advises a permethrin-treated mosquito net and an anti-malarial.
health.es: La malaria es frecuente en Comoras y el texto aconseja mosquitero tratado con permetrina y antipalúdico.
health.quote: Malaria, including cerebral malaria, is prevalent in the Comoros. Sleep under a permethrin-treated mosquito net and take an anti-malarial.

health.en: Medical facilities on all 3 islands of Comoros are basic and most are private.
health.es: Los centros médicos de las 3 islas de Comoras son básicos y la mayoría son privados.
health.quote: Medical facilities on all 3 islands of Comoros are basic and most are private.

health.en: Make sure you have adequate travel insurance and accessible funds for any medical treatment and repatriation.
health.es: Asegúrate de tener un seguro de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles para cualquier tratamiento médico y repatriación.
health.quote: Makes sure you have adequate travel insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment and repatriation.

health.en: Tap water is drinkable according to the National Tourism Office, but the CDC states that it is not.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable según la Oficina Nacional de Turismo, pero los CDC afirman que no lo es.
health.quote: Tap water is drinkable according to the National Tourism Office, however the CDC states that it is not drinkable.

help.en: For an ambulance on Grande Comore, hospital El Maarouf is +269 773 26 04.
help.es: Para una ambulancia en Gran Comora, el hospital El Maarouf es el +269 773 26 04.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Comoros are 113 or 114 for fire and 117 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Comoras son 113 o 114 para bomberos y 117 para la policía.
help.quote: Emergency services in Comoros Fire: 113 or 114 Police: 117

getting_in.en: Kenya Airways flies direct from Nairobi three times a week, connecting with London, Dubai, Mumbai and Paris flights.
getting_in.es: Kenya Airways vuela directo desde Nairobi tres veces por semana, con conexiones desde Londres, Dubái, Bombay y París.
getting_in.quote: Kenya Airways flies direct from Nairobi, thrice a week, connecting with London, Dubai, Mumbai and Paris flights

getting_in.en: Ethiopian Airlines flies direct daily from Addis Ababa via Dar es Salaam.
getting_in.es: Ethiopian Airlines vuela directo a diario desde Adís Abeba vía Dar es Salaam.
getting_in.quote: Ethiopian Airlines flies direct daily from Addis Ababa via Dar es Salaam, connecting with over 100 international destinations

getting_in.en: Air Austral flies from Paris and Marseilles with a change of planes in Saint Denis, Reunion.
getting_in.es: Air Austral vuela desde París y Marsella con cambio de avión en Saint-Denis, Reunión.
getting_in.quote: Air Austral flies from Paris and Marseilles with change of planes in Saint Denis, Reunion

getting_in.en: Inter Iles Air flies from Mayotte to Anjouan and Moroni several times a week.
getting_in.es: Inter Iles Air vuela de Mayotte a Anjouan y Moroni varias veces por semana.
getting_in.quote: Inter Iles Air flies from Mayotte to Anjouan and Moroni several times a week

getting_in.en: Freighters leave from Zanzibar, Dar es Salaam and Madagascar.
getting_in.es: Hay cargueros que salen de Zanzíbar, Dar es Salaam y Madagascar.
getting_in.quote: There are freighters that leave from Zanzibar or Dar es Salaam (in Tanzania) and Madagascar.

getting_in.en: Turkish Airlines has a seasonal route from Istanbul.
getting_in.es: Turkish Airlines tiene una ruta estacional desde Estambul.
getting_in.quote: Turkish airlines has a seasonal route from Istanbul

getting_around.en: Int'Air Îles flies between Moroni, Anjouan and Moheli daily.
getting_around.es: Int'Air Îles vuela a diario entre Moroni, Anjouan y Mohéli.
getting_around.quote: Int'Air Îles flies between Moroni, Anjouan, and Moheli daily.

getting_around.en: Cars can be rented on Grand Comore for approximately CF15,000 to CF25,000 a day, depending on the car.
getting_around.es: En Gran Comora se pueden alquilar coches por unos 15.000 a 25.000 CF al día, según el tipo.
getting_around.quote: It's possible to rent cars on Grand Comore for approximately CF15,000 to CF25,000 a day, depending on the type of car.

getting_around.en: Buses are usually packed, have no fixed schedule and stop running well before sunset.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses suelen ir llenos, no tienen horario fijo y dejan de circular mucho antes del atardecer.
getting_around.quote: Buses are usually packed, have no fixed schedule and stop running well before sunset.

getting_around.en: Shared taxis are the most common mode of public transport within cities.
getting_around.es: Los taxis compartidos son el transporte público más común dentro de las ciudades.
getting_around.quote: Shared taxis are the most common mode of public transport within cities.

getting_around.en: The company Maria Galanta operates the Moroni, Anjouan, Mayotte boat route twice per week.
getting_around.es: La compañía Maria Galanta opera la ruta en barco Moroni, Anjouan y Mayotte dos veces por semana.
getting_around.quote: The company Maria Galanta operates the route Moroni—Moutsamoudou (Anjouan)—Dzaoudzi (Mayotte) twice per week.

getting_around.en: On Grande Comore the main ring-road is of a reasonable standard, but many other roads are in poor condition.
getting_around.es: En Gran Comora la carretera de circunvalación principal es de calidad razonable, pero muchas otras vías están en mal estado.
getting_around.quote: On Grande Comore, the main ring-road is of a reasonable standard, but many other roads are in poor condition.

money.en: There are very few banks or ATMs on the islands, and people mainly use cash.
money.es: Hay muy pocos bancos o cajeros en las islas y la gente usa sobre todo efectivo.
money.quote: There are very few banks or ATMs in Grande Comore or on the other islands. People in Comoros mainly use cash.

money.en: The text says it is best to bring euro notes to the island.
money.es: El texto dice que lo mejor es llevar billetes en euros a la isla.
money.quote: It is best to bring euro notes to the island.

money.en: There are four ATMs in Moroni, but travellers report they are often broken and cannot be relied on.
money.es: Hay cuatro cajeros en Moroni, pero los viajeros dicen que a menudo están averiados y no son fiables.
money.quote: There are four ATMs in Moroni in roughly the same area, however travellers report they are often broken and cannot be relied on.

money.en: Banks may charge about 10% of the withdrawal amount as transaction fees.
money.es: Los bancos pueden cobrar cerca del 10% del importe retirado como comisión.
money.quote: Banks may charge about 10% of withdrawal amount as transaction fees.

money.en: When prices are also given in euros, a fixed exchange rate of €1 = CF500 is used.
money.es: Cuando los precios se dan también en euros, se usa un cambio fijo de 1 € = 500 CF.
money.quote: In those cases, an invariable exchange rate of €1 = CF500 is used.

money.en: Prices tend to be more expensive than in the rest of East Africa.
money.es: Los precios tienden a ser más caros que en el resto de África oriental.
money.quote: Because the Comoros are isolated islands, prices tend to be more expensive than the rest of East Africa.

etiquette.en: Clothing for men and women needs to cover the body loosely, from the shoulders to the knees.
etiquette.es: La ropa de hombres y mujeres debe cubrir el cuerpo con holgura, de los hombros a las rodillas.
etiquette.quote: Clothing for men and women needs to cover the body loosely, from the shoulders to the knees.

etiquette.en: It is disrespectful for women to expose their shoulders, much of their chest, knees, and especially stomach and lower back.
etiquette.es: Es una falta de respeto que las mujeres muestren hombros, buena parte del pecho, rodillas y, sobre todo, estómago y zona lumbar.
etiquette.quote: it is disrespectful for women to expose their shoulders, much of their chest, knees, and especially stomach and lower back.

etiquette.en: Public affection between men and women is not acceptable.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto entre hombres y mujeres no son aceptables.
etiquette.quote: Public affection between men and women is not acceptable

etiquette.en: Non-Muslim religious proselytizing is illegal, as is giving Bibles to locals.
etiquette.es: El proselitismo religioso no musulmán es ilegal, al igual que regalar Biblias a los locales.
etiquette.quote: Non-Muslim religious proselytizing is illegal, as is giving Bibles to locals.

etiquette.en: Ask people for permission before photographing them and avoid photos of public buildings, particularly military and police ones.
etiquette.es: Pide permiso antes de fotografiar a la gente y evita fotografiar edificios públicos, sobre todo militares y policiales.
etiquette.quote: It is advisable to ask people for permission before photographing them. Avoid taking photos of public buildings, particularly military and police buildings.

etiquette.en: Drinking alcohol in public is disrespectful, though it occurs in nightclubs.
etiquette.es: Beber alcohol en público es una falta de respeto, aunque ocurre en las discotecas.
etiquette.quote: Drinking alcohol in public is disrespectful, though it occurs in nightclubs.
